title: Michigan Dispensary Guides for All 8 Stores
metaDescription: Plan a visit to any of High Society's 8 Michigan dispensaries: hours, directions, what to bring, ordering ahead for pickup and each store's own FAQ.
h1: Your Guide to Every High Society Dispensary

hero.lead: Each of our eight Michigan stores has its own visitor guide: hours, directions, what to bring, how pickup works and that store’s FAQ. Pick your store below, or read the basics that hold at every location first.

blocks.heading: Pick your store
blocks.lead: Every store is open Monday - Sunday, 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM. Open a store’s guide for directions, its pickup steps and its FAQ.

blocks.heading: What every store has in common
blocks.lead: A few things hold at all eight locations, so a first visit anywhere goes smoothly.

items.title: Bring your ID
items.md: Adult-use shopping is for 21 and older: bring a valid government-issued ID or passport and check in at the front desk. Registered medical patients bring their card too. 21+ only. Please consume responsibly.

items.title: Paying
items.md: Cash works at every store, and each store page lists an ATM in-store. Other payment options vary by store, so call ahead for details.

items.title: Order ahead
items.md: Shop in store, or order online and choose a pickup time for in-store or curbside pickup. Curbside customers get a text when the order is ready.

items.title: Join The Society
items.md: Our loyalty program is free. Members earn points on qualifying purchases and redeem them in store or online. [See how it works](/loyalty/).

blocks.heading: Coming from Indiana, Chicago or Harbor Country?
blocks.lead: Our New Buffalo store sits on US-12, minutes from I-94 Exit 1 and just over the Indiana line. These pages cover routes, parking and quick-stop tips. Whichever way you come, cannabis bought in Michigan stays in Michigan.
